description: Settings shared by every experimental condition. A condition file in configs/conditions/ may add settings but may not redefine any key here. Rationale for each value: MODELS.md and docs/notes/extraction-diagnosis.md.

query.user_prompt: Reply with only the short answer phrase: a name, a date, a place, a number, or yes/no. For yes/no questions reply with exactly yes or no. Do not write a sentence, an explanation, Markdown, or a References section. If the context does not contain the answer, reply with exactly: unknown
